name: Dam Break
description: The first clip is a body of water held back by a dam on one side: the dam gives way, its top sinks toward the open side into a long rippling slope with a glossy, foaming surface that rushes out of the frame, stretching the picture along the flow, and the rest drains away, revealing the second clip. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: gloss
params.description: Strength of the glossy highlight along the water surface

params.name: foam
params.description: Amount of foam on the surface, growing where the water runs fastest

params.name: leftward
params.description: Flow toward the left instead of the right
